requirements.title: IBITS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer; POS shall be an integer nonnegative value with POS+LEN not greater than BIT_SIZE(I); LEN shall be an integer nonnegative value.

requirements.title: IBITS extracts and right-adjusts LEN bits
requirements.definition: The IBITS result contains the LEN bits of I beginning at POS right-adjusted, with every other bit zero, using the integer bit model of 16.3.
